test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when placed from left to right in the same sequence in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

XY_YZ_ _XYY_ _ABXY_ _ZAB_ _YYZA_
solution:
**Given series:** XY_YZ_ _XYY_ _ABXY_ _ZAB_ _YYZA_

Option 1) YZBYZYYXYB → XY__Y__YZ__Z__ __B__XYY__Y__ __Z__ABXY__Y__ __Y__ZAB__X__ __Y__YYZA__ B__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) YABYZYYXYY → XY__Y__YZ__A__ __B__XYY__Y__ __Z__ABXY__Y__ __Y__ZAB__X__ __Y__YYZA__ Y__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) XABYZYYXYB → XY__X__YZ__A__ __B__XYY__Y__ __Z__ABXY__Y__ __Y__ZAB__X__ __Y__YYZA__ B__ → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) YABYZYYXYB → XY__**Y**__YZ__**A**__ __**B**__XYY__**Y**__ __**Z**__ABXY__**Y**__ __**Y**__ZAB__**X**__ __**Y**__YYZA**__ B__** → **(It follows the pattern**** of: XYYYZAB - XYYYZAB - XYYYZAB - XYYYZAB)**

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
